rm-one-file.title: Delete One Exact File Safely
rm-one-file.bodyMarkdown:
Before `rm`, inspect the directory and confirm the exact temporary filename. Then remove only that file and list the directory again to verify the result.

Avoid recursive flags and broad wildcards in this course.

move-to-trash-alternative.title: When Unsure, Move to Review
move-to-trash-alternative.bodyMarkdown: If you are not certain a file should be deleted, preserve it. Create a review or archive directory and move the file there instead. Delete only when the target is known to be disposable.
